task.description:
Perform WF-02 Step 3b (test design gate, HARD GATE) for REQ-373 per docs/agents/workflows/WF-02_requirement_implementation.md and your role file .claude/agents/test-design-validator.md. Read the test spec and test source files INDEPENDENTLY. For each of REQ-373's 8 acceptance criteria, verify: (a) at least one runnable test targets it (not @tag :skip without a passing counterpart); (b) no 'TODO: implement test' left in the spec; (c) test fixtures use per-test unique data, no cross-test pollution; (d) tests are self-sufficient, don't depend on other tests running first; (e) no hardcoded secrets/connection strings.

SPECIFICALLY INVESTIGATE a flagged concern from ELIXIR-DEV's rework (step-03a-elixir-dev-fix.json result): a test-isolation gap in test/letflow/engine_pin_resolver_catalog_test.exs's unique_service_id/1 fixture -- it uses System.unique_integer/1, which resets per BEAM VM restart, while service_catalog_versions is deliberately append-only and never cleaned between runs, so repeated mix test invocations in the same BEAM session can collide with leftover archive rows from an earlier run within that same session. Determine whether this is a genuine self-sufficiency/isolation violation (check (c)/(d) above) that must be fixed before this gate can PASS, or an acceptable characteristic given how ExUnit/Ecto sandbox mode actually isolates test runs (Ecto.Adapters.SQL.Sandbox typically rolls back each test's transaction, which would make this concern moot for a SINGLE mix test invocation but real only for the literal multiple-invocations-in-one-BEAM-session scenario ELIXIR-DEV described) -- verify by reading how service_catalog_versions rows are actually written (inside a sandboxed transaction or not) rather than assuming either way.

FAIL immediately on any check failure -- no partial credit. Set status to COMPLETED, commit and push before ending your turn.
acceptance_criteria: service_catalog entries carry a version identity and an ACTIVE/RETIRED status, with the chosen schema (composite key vs. status+sibling table) stated explicitly in the moduledoc along with the reasoning, proven by a migration and a schema test

publishing a new version of an existing service_id does not alter or invalidate any already-resolved pinned_version entry recorded in a prior INSTANCE_STARTED event, proven by a test that resolves a pin, publishes a new version, and re-derives the same instance's effective pin set unchanged
a new case created after a publish resolves the newly published version via Letflow.Engine.PinResolver.resolve/4's real (non-default) Lookup, proven by a test

retiring a version prevents any NEW resolution from choosing it while an instance already pinned to the retired version continues to resolve via pin_for/3 with no error, proven by a test covering both sides
Engine.create/2's pin_lookup/2 helper is wired to the real catalog-backed Lookup for catalog_entry references in place of PinResolver.default_lookup/0, proven by an integration test
publish/retire operations are gated behind the already-shipped :AdminServicesManage permission, not a newly invented permission name, proven by a test
PLC-01/module_ref catalog versioning is explicitly named as still out of scope in the moduledoc (not a test-code requirement)
mix letflow.check passes, with real output quoted (TEST-RUNNER's job, not this gate's)
